Quick Summary

Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes e.V. offers Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes (German Academic Scholarship Foundation), a fully funded opportunity designed for international students heading to Germany. The award covers 300 EUR monthly study allowance plus up to 812 EUR monthly need-based stipend and is open to bachelor, master, state examination, and phd students studying all academic disciplines, including arts, music, and design. The scholarship runs for for the duration of the standard period of study (regelstudienzeit) and may be renewed annually based on academic performance. Eligibility is generally based on candidates must demonstrate outstanding academic performance (top 2-5%), broad intellectual interests, and a commitment to society. The application deadline is February (for self-nomination test); Rolling/Termly for school and university nominations, with an acceptance rate of estimated at less than 1% of the total German student population. Applicants are encouraged to review the official eligibility criteria carefully before starting their application.

The Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes is Germany's largest and most prestigious scholarship provider. It is independent, non-political, and non-denominational, supporting students of all disciplines who exhibit exceptional talent and social engagement.
👥 Who Should Apply
Candidates must demonstrate outstanding academic performance (top 2-5%), broad intellectual interests, and a commitment to society.
🏛️ Host University
Any state-recognized university in Germany, or universities in the EU/Switzerland for German citizens
🤝 Sponsor
German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)
🎨 Fields of Study
All academic disciplines, including arts, music, and design
✨ Key Benefits
Recipients receive a non-repayable 300 EUR monthly study allowance and a potential need-based stipend. The program emphasizes ideational support through academic seminars and networking.
🎯 Target Students
Exceptionally gifted students with a sense of social responsibility
